messages:
anna_cs: Heads-up — PolyArch just told me their Legal & Compliance team is starting a pilot tomorrow and wants to index ~50GB/day of contracts for embeddings + extractive Q&A. They asked about guidance for rate limits and SAML SSO for new users.

sam_solutions: Nice signal. Do we know which model/profile they'll use? embeddings-only or embeddings + reranking?

anna_cs: They'll start with embeddings (semantic search) and then add a summarization layer. Target latency matters for their UI, but main ask is ingest throughput.

leo_eng: 50GB/day is ~5-6M embedding vectors/day depending on chunking. Current hosted quota for their org is 1M/day. We should propose incremental burst or Dedicated pilot.

matt_pm: From product POV, recommend trying workload on quantized open model -> lowers cost. But we need logs to validate latency under 2s for interactive search.

anna_cs: Action items I captured: 1) temporary quota bump to 6M embeddings/day 2) SAML enablement ticket 3) short enablement session for their docs team. @leo_eng can you put in the quota request?

leo_eng: On it. Raising internal ticket now. Snippet for ops:```/quota modify --org polyarch --embeddings 6000000 --reason "pilot: legal team ingestion"``` I'll mark as high priority.

sam_solutions: I can run a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow at 10am PT and share chunking + prompt templates. Also will send a sample ingestion pipeline config.

ops_bot: Automated note: PolyArch is on plan "Scale Starter" — next renewal in 85 days. Recent usage trend: +420% MoM for embeddings. Flag: potential expansion -> update ARR projection.

anna_cs: Thanks team. Two risks: (a) SAML delays -> onboarding friction (b) if latency >2s they may ask for Dedicated which is sales motion. I'll follow up with renewal owner and cc in the SAML ticket. :thumbsup:

matt_pm: Good. Please capture feedback on summarization quality after first 48 hours so we can tune model recommendations.

anna_cs: Will do — I'll update this thread after the walkthrough and the quota change.
